header_subtitle: Cloud Native Nginx Builder · Go Engine
step_3_desc: Download and compile third-party libraries statically into Nginx binary without system dependencies.
conflict_alert_sub: (A resolution prompt will appear when you click build)
modal_desc: The currently selected configure options contain the following mutual exclusion conflicts:
modal_advice: Smart Recommendation: Click "Auto-Resolve & Build" below. The system will retain primary functional modules, safely remove contradictory exclusion flags, satisfy missing dependencies, and start the build immediately.

options.http_ssl: Enable HTTP SSL/TLS protocol support (HTTPS) with SNI and modern cipher suites
options.http_v3: Enable HTTP/3 (QUIC) protocol support (requires QUIC-capable OpenSSL)
options.stream_ssl: Enable Stream TCP/UDP SSL/TLS termination and proxy support
options.stream_ssl_preread: Enable Stream SSL ClientHello preread module (route by SNI/ALPN without decryption)
options.mail_ssl: Enable Mail module SSL/TLS support (STARTTLS / SSL)
options.http_realip: Enable RealIP module (rewrite client IP based on X-Forwarded-For / PROXY header)
options.http_addition: Enable Addition module (append subrequest contents before and after response body)
options.http_sub: Enable Sub module (find and replace string patterns in HTTP responses)
options.http_dav: Enable WebDAV module (supports PUT, DELETE, MKCOL, COPY, MOVE methods)
options.http_flv: Enable FLV pseudo-streaming media delivery support
options.http_mp4: Enable MP4 streaming media delivery support with start/end seek timestamps
options.http_gunzip: Enable Gunzip module (dynamically decompress gzip responses for non-gzip clients)
options.http_gzip_static: Enable Gzip Static module (directly send precompressed .gz files from disk)
options.http_auth_request: Enable Auth Request module (client authorization based on subrequest result)
options.http_random_index: Enable Random Index module (selects a random directory index file to serve)
options.http_secure_link: Enable Secure Link module (protect resources via MD5 hash and expiry timestamps)
options.http_degradation: Enable Degradation module (return 204 or 444 when system memory is constrained)
options.http_slice: Enable Slice module (splits big files into range subrequests for caching)
options.http_stub_status: Enable Stub Status module (provides basic metrics and status monitoring page)
options.http_xslt: Enable XML XSLT response transformation filter
options.http_image_filter: Enable Image Filter module (dynamically scale, crop, and transform images)
options.http_geoip: Enable GeoIP module (IP geolocation lookup and routing)
options.stream: Enable Stream layer-4 TCP/UDP reverse proxy and load balancing core engine
options.stream_realip: Enable Stream PROXY Protocol client real IP extraction and parsing
options.stream_geoip: Enable Stream GeoIP geolocation routing module
options.mail: Enable Mail proxy support (POP3 / IMAP / SMTP reverse proxy)
options.threads: Enable asynchronous thread pools to decouple blocking file I/O operations
options.file_aio: Enable Linux kernel asynchronous file I/O (File AIO) for high disk throughput
options.pcre_jit: Enable PCRE regular expression Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation acceleration
options.compat: Enable dynamic module binary compatibility layer for external .so modules
options.cpp_test: Enable C++ test compatibility check module
options.select_module: Force compilation of the select() event model module
options.without_select_module: Explicitly disable select() event model module
options.poll_module: Force compilation of the poll() event model module
options.without_poll_module: Explicitly disable poll() event model module
options.without_http: Completely disable HTTP subsystem (for pure Stream TCP/UDP or Mail proxy)
options.without_http_cache: Completely disable HTTP file cache mechanism
options.without_pcre: Disable PCRE regex library (mandates disabling rewrite module; conflicts with JIT)
options.without_http_gzip: Disable HTTP Gzip on-the-fly response compression module
options.without_http_grpc: Disable gRPC reverse proxy gateway module

env_banner_desc: The build server is missing required compilers or libraries. Click to automatically install them.
env_missing_compile_warn: Missing essential compilation dependencies on server. Would you like to open the dependency installer?
preset_modal_desc: Select a curated scenario template to instantly populate recommended configure flags, or reset defaults.
preset_modern_web_desc: Production recommended: Enables HTTPS (SSL/TLS), HTTP/2, Stream L4 proxy, RealIP extraction, Gzip Static precompressed file serving, status monitoring, and asynchronous thread pool acceleration.
preset_full_featured_desc: Enables almost all mainstream official modules: HTTP/2, HTTP/3 (QUIC), full L4 Stream proxy, SNI preread, XSLT, Image Filter, GeoIP, Slice caching, Secure Link, and dynamic compatibility layer.
preset_minimal_desc: Strips FastCGI, uWSGI, SCGI, gRPC and other unneeded gateway protocols to build an ultra-lightweight, high-performance binary for pure static asset delivery.
preset_media_streaming_desc: Optimized for video-on-demand and large downloads: MP4 seekable streaming, FLV pseudo-streaming, Slice caching, Secure Link token hashing, and high-concurrency File AIO.
preset_l4_gateway_desc: Focused on high-performance transport-layer streaming: TCP/UDP load balancing, SSL termination/passthrough, SNI / ALPN preread without decryption, and Proxy Protocol client IP passing.
preset_security_hardened_desc: Focuses on encrypted transmission and strict access validation: HTTPS/QUIC, subrequest authentication (Auth Request), timestamped token protection (Secure Link), and RealIP parsing.
preset_dynamic_compat_desc: Enables --with-compat to preserve ABI compatibility for hot-loading external .so dynamic modules later, with asynchronous thread pools and PCRE JIT enabled.
